verdict.rationale: Brex documents a dedicated Webhooks API: you register an endpoint URL and choose which webhook events to receive (brex-docs-35, brex-docs-1). An example event, a referral activating, is given (brex-docs-25). This is a registrable outbound HTTP callback mechanism that a programmatic consumer can subscribe to. Missing for 10: a documented catalog of event types beyond the referral example, details on signature verification and retry/delivery guarantees, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
